we have introduced three new datasets recorded by a neuromorphic vision DAVIS346red sensor, and three encoding methods to convert the spatiotemporal data format into a conventional RGB frame format.

the proposed datasets and encoding methods are the first of their kind for human motion analysis and they can be used to evaluate and compare the performance of algorithms processing event based data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we introduce three new large scale neuromorphic vision based datasets which are recorded in a real world environment and are open access for the community.
we introduce three large neuromorphic vision human motion related datasets which will benefit the neuromorphic, computer vision and robotics communities.
we introduce the largest open access neuromorphic vision dataset for three human motion related applications, namely pedestrian detection, action recognition and fall detection.
